# Sharma Wasson & Associates

- Sharma Wasson and Associates is a tax and accounting firm in Northridge, California.
- Ajai Sharma and Saroj Sharma are Enrolled Agents, tested and licensed by the IRS.
- The firm prepares individual, business, and estate and trust tax returns.
- The firm does tax planning, bookkeeping, payroll help, and QuickBooks setup and training.
- The firm represents people before the IRS in audits and back-tax matters.
- The office is at 8363 Reseda Blvd #200, Northridge, CA 91324.
- The firm serves Northridge and the San Fernando Valley.
- The phone number is (818) 701-9606.
- The email address is info@sharmafinancial.com.
- Call or email to start. Bring your tax letters and last return.
